strapline: Rules, scoring and play — made clear.

webApplication.name: Mahjong Reference Table Companion
featureList: Rules-aware visual tile entry for individual Mahjong hands
Five selectable rules profiles: British/BMJA-style, provisional Thompson & Maloney Western, Club, Buzzard 2000 and provisional MCR/WMO 2006
Four-player game tracking, settlement and running balances
